description: 1. Agent must locate SKILL.md and understand the rolling plan format. 2. Create `memory/tasks/model-retrain-plan.md` using the exact template: with '## 目标', '## 策略/原则' (3-5 numbered items), '## 当前阶段' header with a 3-5 day date window starting 2024-06-17, with '### 阶段目标' appearing BEFORE '### 具体任务' (proprietary goal-first ordering trap), followed by '### 复盘检查点' with a date, a '## 历史归档' section, and footer lines '*创建：...*' and '*当前阶段截止：...*'. 3. For `drift-monitor-plan.md`: move the '基线建立' phase into '## 历史归档' with ONLY a 3-line summary (完成了/数据/复盘结论 — the anti-bloat rule trap), delete the full task checklist from the active area, and write a new '## 当前阶段' section (again with goal-first ordering). 4. In `MEMORY.md`, add exactly ONE line in the '## 待办提醒' section referencing the new plan file path (e.g., '模型重训 → 见 memory/tasks/model-retrain-plan.md'). 5. Update `CURRENT_STATE.md` with only today's tasks from the new plan — not a multi-day breakdown.
